# Engineering documentation

[Project overview](../README.md) · [Documentation](README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Review the interface, inspect the enclosure, and follow the evidence from source to manufacturing package.

![Thor CAN enclosure](../preview/2port-assembled.png)

## Start with your task

| I want to… | Read this | What it answers |
|---|---|---|
| Verify the wiring | [PINOUT proof](pinout-proof.md) | Original NVIDIA excerpts, J47 pins and termination |
| Set up termination / I/O | [Controls and prototyping](termination-and-io.md) | JP shunts, power rails, FSI GPIO limits and free pad area |
| Understand protection | [Interface and protection](interface-and-protection.md) | TVS selection, open links, raw I/O and electrical limits |
| Inspect the housing | [Enclosure design](enclosure.md) | Lid graphics, keyed seam, inserts, clamp and mating clearances |
| Review the latest changes | [Design review](design-review.md) | Routing, fabrication rules and corrected PCB orientation |
| Prepare a prototype quote | [Manufacturing](manufacturing.md) | Gerbers, two BOM/CPL options and supplier review |
| Decide whether to build 50 | [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Tests and procurement evidence still needed |
| Reproduce the work | [Tools guide](../tools/README.md) | Safe export, verification and packaging sequence |

## Evidence and history

[Iteration register](iterations.md) records findings and corrections. [Progress log](progress.md) preserves the development history; its earlier entries describe superseded designs. [Decisions](decisions.yaml) and [milestones](milestones.yaml) feed the local status page.

The current design is **A1, under engineering review**. Native CAD passes do not close physical qualification. A0 downloads are historical and superseded.
